# Sound handling

`cinnabar:extension/sound-handling@0.1.0`

Requested sound playback before it starts, for `handle-sound`.

**Grants:** `audio` to run handle-sound; this interface only defines handler types.

## Types

<a id="type-position"></a>

### `position`

World coordinates in blocks; absent for non-positional playback.

```wit
record position {
    x: f32,
    y: f32,
    z: f32,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | `f32` |  |
| `y` | `f32` |  |
| `z` | `f32` |  |

<a id="type-sound-context"></a>

### `sound-context`

One new playback request after event routing to an exact sound definition. Only
`cancelled` is changeable.

```wit
record sound-context {
    name: string,
    position: option<position>,
    looping: bool,
    cancelled: bool,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | Exact definition name, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes. |
| `position` | `option<position>` | Requested world location; none is non-positional playback. |
| `looping` | `bool` | Whether this request starts a repeating voice. |
| `cancelled` | `bool` | Whether the request is discarded; false unless an earlier handler cancelled it. |

Types: [`position`](sound-handling.md#type-position).

## Functions

This interface defines shared types and has no functions.
